native_summary.name: A1_tracking__online300

command.name: A1_tracking__online300
command.initial_provenance_scope: Generic prescribed initial-state artifact, not a GN/static/oldcheckpoint qualification

native_summary.velocity_metric_semantics: Preserved root translational freejoint qvel RMS; angular body qvel norm is frame invariant, not a new COM-velocity gate.
native_summary.nonpad_metric_definition: Maximum across PRE ticks of the SUM of positive Fn over every phone contact with non-designated hand geoms; same aggregation as original two-pad gate. old_two_pad also includes all positive Fn on geom41.
native_summary.control_scope: Planned50Hz controller only; trace pre_executed_ctrl20 is actual perPRE-tick command. Legacy trace ctrl20 is last command and ctrl_margin20x2 describes initial source only. Raw integration receipts protect callback state; no full-MjData certificate.
native_summary.native_loop_and_physical_success_gates_f: frozen functional_tripod_dynamics_v3, unchanged after insertion of explicit control hook and schedule fields

tracking.scope: Full SO3 angle and COM tracking descriptors, not holding5mm success; no missing-tail fill, temporal stretch or accumulated-clock tick index
